_metadata.image_policy: image_url fields use Unsplash keyword URLs as temporary placeholders. Replace with real vendor photos during onboarding. image_hint field describes EXACTLY what the real photo must show. Never use a generic food image - match the specific dish.
_metadata.import_note: Import using Firebase Admin SDK seed script. Document IDs are in the _id field of each object.

categories.name: Kenyan Staples
categories.description: Ugali, rice, beans and classic home-cooked Kenyan meals
categories.icon_hint: Plate of ugali with beef stew and sukuma wiki - Kenyan style, NOT western food

categories.name: Grilled & Choma
categories.description: Nyama choma, mishkaki, mutura and fire-grilled favourites
categories.icon_hint: Nyama choma on a charcoal grill or plated with kachumbari - East African style, NOT American BBQ ribs

categories.name: Street Food
categories.description: Smokie pasua, samosa, viazi karai, mandazi and campus snacks
categories.icon_hint: Kenyan street food - samosa or smokie pasua in bread with kachumbari - NOT western junk food

categories.name: Breakfast
categories.description: Chai, uji, mandazi, eggs and Kenyan morning favourites
categories.icon_hint: Cup of Kenyan chai (tea with milk) with mandazi on the side - NOT an espresso or western breakfast plate

categories.name: Drinks & Juices
categories.description: Fresh juices, smoothies, sugarcane, madafu and cold drinks
categories.icon_hint: Glass of fresh tropical juice - mango, passion fruit or watermelon - vibrant, colourful, NOT a canned drink

categories.name: Pilau & Rice
categories.description: Kenyan pilau, biryani, wali wa nazi and spiced rice dishes
categories.icon_hint: Plate of Kenyan pilau - dark brown spiced rice with whole spices (cumin, cardamom) and meat - NOT Indian biryani or plain white rice

categories.name: Coastal Kenyan
categories.description: Swahili coastal dishes - wali wa nazi, mahamri, kuku wa kupaka, samaki
categories.icon_hint: Wali wa nazi (coconut rice) or mahamri - Swahili coastal food aesthetic, warm tones, NOT beach/tourism imagery

categories.name: Fast Food
categories.description: Chips, fried chicken, burgers and campus quick bites
categories.icon_hint: Kenyan-style chips (thick cut fries) with fried chicken - served on a plate or in a paper bag, NOT a branded fast food chain

vendors.name: Mama Njeri's Kitchen
vendors.tagline: Home-cooked Kenyan flavours, just like mama made
vendors.description: Classic Kenyan home cooking served fresh daily. Known for the best ugali and beef stew on campus. Everything is made from scratch every morning.
vendors.location_description: Opposite KCA Gate B, ground floor, blue signboard
vendors.logo_hint: Photo of the vendor stall front or Mama Njeri herself at her stall - warm, welcoming, genuine. NOT a stock photo of a chef.
vendors.banner_hint: Ugali with beef stew and sukuma wiki on a plate - this is the vendor's signature dish. Must look authentically Kenyan.

vendors.name: Kibandaski Corner
vendors.description: The classic Nairobi kibanda experience. Chapati, beans, githeri and everything in between at student-friendly prices. The realest campus food you will find.
vendors.location_description: KCA Shopping Centre, stall 3, ask for Kamau
vendors.logo_hint: Photo of the kibandaski stall - informal, local setting, pots on the counter, NOT a restaurant kitchen
vendors.banner_hint: Chapati (2 pieces) with madondo (beans) on a simple plate - the vendor's bestseller. Authentic and unfiltered.

vendors.name: Choma Zone
vendors.description: Nyama choma, mishkaki and mutura straight off the charcoal grill. The best evening spot near KCA. Come after 4PM for the freshest cuts.
vendors.location_description: Behind KCA parking area, open air charcoal grill - follow the smoke
vendors.logo_hint: Meat on a charcoal grill with smoke rising - Kenyan nyama choma style, outdoor setting. NOT American BBQ.
vendors.banner_hint: Plated nyama choma (goat or beef) with kachumbari (tomato onion salsa) and ugali on the side. East African presentation.

vendors.name: Snack Attack
vendors.description: Smokie pasua, samosa, viazi karai, mandazi and all the in-between-lectures snacks a student needs. Always hot, always ready.
vendors.location_description: KCA main entrance kiosk, right side of the gate
vendors.logo_hint: Photo of the snack kiosk with samosas and smokies visibly on display - street-side, informal, Kenyan. NOT a food court stand.
vendors.banner_hint: Assortment of Kenyan street snacks on a tray or board - samosa, smokie pasua in bread, mandazi. Must look street-authentic.

vendors.name: Morning Glory
vendors.description: Kenyan breakfast done right. Chai, uji, mandazi, eggs and chapati to power you through morning lectures. Closes at noon - don't miss it.
vendors.location_description: Near KCA Library entrance, the blue and yellow stall
vendors.logo_hint: Cup of Kenyan chai (milky tea) with mandazi on the side - simple, warm, morning vibe. NOT a cappuccino or western brunch.
vendors.banner_hint: Kenyan breakfast spread - chai in a mug, mandazi, boiled egg, chapati on a simple plate. Authentic morning food.

vendors.name: Pilau Palace
vendors.description: The best pilau and biryani near KCA. Slow-cooked with authentic Kenyan spices - cumin, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves. Come early, it runs out.
vendors.location_description: KCA Shopping Centre, stall 7, red and white signboard
vendors.logo_hint: Close-up of Kenyan pilau in a pot or on a plate - dark brown, spiced, whole spices visible, meat visible. NOT Indian restaurant plating.
vendors.banner_hint: Generous plate of Kenyan pilau with kachumbari on the side - the hero shot. Dark brown spiced rice, real Kenyan style.

vendors.name: The Chapati House
vendors.tagline: Soft, layered, made fresh every hour
vendors.description: Freshly rolled and cooked chapati, made to order. Paired with beans, ndengu, nyama, egg or avocado. The softest chapati on Thika Road.
vendors.location_description: Next to KCA Student Centre, follow the rolling pin sound
vendors.logo_hint: Stack of freshly made Kenyan chapati - soft, layered, slightly golden brown. NOT Indian paratha, NOT Mexican tortilla.
vendors.banner_hint: 2 chapati with beans (madondo) on a simple plate - classic Kenyan chapo-madondo combo. Authentic, not styled.

vendors.name: Campus Bites
vendors.description: Chips, fried chicken, burgers and chipsi mayai. The go-to fast food spot for students on the run between lectures.
vendors.location_description: Ground floor, KCA Shopping Centre - corner stall
vendors.logo_hint: Plate of Kenyan chips (thick-cut fries) with fried chicken - simple, filling, campus style. NOT a branded KFC or McDonald's.
vendors.banner_hint: Chips with kuku (fried chicken pieces) and tomato sauce on a plate or paper - Kenyan campus fast food, NOT western fast food chain.

vendors.name: Fresh Sip
vendors.description: Fresh-pressed juices, tropical smoothies, sugarcane and madafu. All natural, zero preservatives, made in front of you.
vendors.location_description: KCA main entrance, left kiosk with the fruit display
vendors.logo_hint: Vibrant glass of fresh tropical juice - bright yellow mango or purple passion fruit. Fruits visible nearby. NOT a bottled juice.
vendors.banner_hint: Row of colourful fresh juices on a counter with tropical fruits beside them - mango, passion, watermelon. Vibrant, natural, no branding.

vendors.name: Swahili Plate
vendors.tagline: Coastal flavours in the heart of Nairobi
vendors.description: Authentic Swahili coastal cuisine brought to KCA. Wali wa nazi, mahamri, kuku wa kupaka and samaki - a full taste of the coast.
vendors.location_description: Opposite KCA Gate A, first floor, blue and white decor
vendors.logo_hint: Coastal Kenyan food - plate of wali wa nazi with stew or mahamri on a colourful plate. Warm, aromatic Swahili aesthetic. NOT a beach resort.
vendors.banner_hint: Plate of wali wa nazi (coconut rice) with kuku wa kupaka - rich, golden, aromatic coastal Kenyan food. Real, not styled.

menu_items.name: Ugali + Beef Stew
menu_items.description: Freshly pounded ugali served with slow-cooked beef stew and sukuma wiki on the side
menu_items.image_hint: Plate of ugali (white maize meal cake) with brown beef stew poured over or beside it, sukuma wiki on the side. Kenyan home-cooking style. NOT a burger, NOT pasta, NOT Indian curry.

menu_items.name: Ugali + Fried Tilapia
menu_items.description: Crispy whole tilapia fried golden with ugali and kachumbari on the side
menu_items.image_hint: Whole fried tilapia (the full fish, crispy, golden) on a plate with ugali beside it. East African presentation. NOT a fish fillet, NOT fish and chips.

menu_items.name: Ugali + Sukuma Wiki + Egg
menu_items.description: Classic ugali with sautéed sukuma wiki (kale) and a boiled or fried egg
menu_items.image_hint: Ugali with dark green sukuma wiki (kale) and a fried or boiled egg on a plate. Simple, affordable, authentic Kenyan meal. NOT a spinach salad.

menu_items.name: Wali na Maharage
menu_items.description: Steamed white rice served with Kenyan-style stewed kidney beans
menu_items.image_hint: White rice with dark red kidney beans in thick sauce on a simple plate. Kenyan home cooking. NOT Mexican rice and beans, NOT rice and peas.

menu_items.name: Mukimo
menu_items.description: Traditional Kikuyu mukimo - mashed potato, peas, corn and pumpkin leaves
menu_items.image_hint: Mukimo - a green-tinged mashed mixture of potato, peas and pumpkin leaves on a plate. Traditional Kikuyu dish, slightly dense, earthy green colour. NOT regular mashed potato.

menu_items.name: Githeri
menu_items.description: Slow-simmered mix of maize and kidney beans - Kenyan comfort food at its finest
menu_items.image_hint: Githeri - stewed whole maize kernels mixed with kidney beans in a thick sauce, served in a bowl or plate. Traditional Kenyan dish. NOT corn chowder, NOT succotash.

menu_items.name: Matumbo + Ugali
menu_items.description: Tender beef tripe stewed in a rich tomato and onion sauce, served with ugali
menu_items.image_hint: Matumbo (beef tripe) in dark brown tomato-onion sauce in a bowl or on a plate with ugali. East African presentation. NOT menudo, NOT haggis.

menu_items.name: Liver Stew + Rice
menu_items.description: Sliced beef liver pan-fried with onions, tomatoes and pilipili, served with steamed rice
menu_items.image_hint: Sliced beef liver in brown tomato-onion sauce served with white rice. Kenyan-style liver fry. NOT pâté, NOT liver and onions western style.

menu_items.name: Chapo Madondo
menu_items.description: Two fresh chapati served with a generous portion of stewed madondo (boiled beans)
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati (soft, layered Kenyan flatbread) with dark red boiled beans in thick sauce on a simple plate. Classic Kenya. NOT Indian dal and roti, NOT Mexican beans and tortilla.

menu_items.name: Chapo Ndengu
menu_items.description: Two chapati with stewed green grams (ndengu) cooked with tomatoes and onions
menu_items.image_hint: Chapati with green gram (ndengu/mung beans) stew on the side - yellowish-green lentil-like stew with chapati. Kenyan style. NOT Indian dal.

menu_items.name: Chapo Nyama
menu_items.description: Two chapati with a hearty beef stew - the student favourite for a filling lunch
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati with beef stew (dark brown, thick, chunky meat) poured beside them on a plate. Kenyan street food style. NOT a doner kebab wrap.

menu_items.name: Ugali + Sukuma Wiki
menu_items.description: Simple and satisfying - ugali with freshly sautéed sukuma wiki cooked with tomatoes
menu_items.image_hint: Ugali beside dark green sautéed sukuma wiki (kale). Simple, affordable, authentic Kenyan everyday meal.

menu_items.name: Rice + Cabbage + Beans
menu_items.description: Steamed rice served with a portion of stewed beans and sautéed cabbage
menu_items.image_hint: White rice on a plate with stewed beans and sautéed cabbage portions. Simple Kenyan meal. NOT fried rice.

menu_items.name: Viazi Karai
menu_items.description: Deep-fried potato chunks coated in spiced chickpea batter - crispy, golden and addictive
menu_items.image_hint: Viazi karai - deep-fried potato chunks in golden spiced chickpea batter, served in a paper bag or plate. Kenyan coastal street food. NOT regular chips/fries, NOT bhajia.

menu_items.name: Samosa ya Nyama (2 pcs)
menu_items.description: Two crispy beef samosas filled with spiced minced meat - a Nairobi classic
menu_items.image_hint: Two triangular fried samosas - golden brown, crispy, Kenyan/East African style (thinner pastry than Indian). Can show cut-open one with minced beef filling. NOT Indian restaurant samosa presentation.

menu_items.name: Samosa ya Mboga (2 pcs)
menu_items.description: Two crispy vegetable samosas filled with spiced potato and vegetable mix
menu_items.image_hint: Two triangular fried samosas - vegetable version, golden brown. Can show potato/veg filling if cut open. Same East African style pastry.

menu_items.name: Nyama Choma 200g
menu_items.description: 200g of slow-chargrilled goat or beef, salted and roasted over charcoal. Served with kachumbari.
menu_items.image_hint: Nyama choma - charcoal-grilled goat or beef pieces, slightly charred, served with kachumbari (tomato-onion-coriander salsa). East African plating. NOT American ribs, NOT BBQ brisket.

menu_items.name: Nyama Choma 400g
menu_items.description: Double portion - 400g of charcoal-grilled goat or beef with kachumbari and ugali
menu_items.image_hint: Large generous platter of nyama choma (charcoal-grilled meat) with kachumbari and ugali. Feast-sized. East African presentation.

menu_items.name: Kuku Choma (Half)
menu_items.description: Half a chicken marinated in aromatic spices and chargrilled until golden and smoky
menu_items.image_hint: Half a grilled chicken - charcoal-roasted, golden-brown skin, spiced. East African street-style. NOT KFC fried chicken, NOT rotisserie from a European restaurant.

menu_items.name: Mishkaki (5 sticks)
menu_items.description: Five skewers of marinated beef, chargrilled and served with a spiced dipping sauce
menu_items.image_hint: Mishkaki - East African beef skewers, charcoal grilled, served on wooden skewer sticks. Can show dipping sauce beside them. NOT Turkish shish kebab, NOT satay.

menu_items.name: Mutura
menu_items.description: Traditional Kenyan grilled blood sausage - spiced minced meat and blood in intestine casing, roasted over charcoal
menu_items.image_hint: Mutura - Kenyan grilled blood sausage (dark, charred, coiled or cut into rounds) on a cutting board or plate. Traditional street food. NOT black pudding, NOT chorizo.

menu_items.name: Smokie wa Choma (2 pcs)
menu_items.description: Two smokies (processed sausages) grilled on charcoal until sizzling
menu_items.image_hint: Two grilled smokies (processed sausages) on a grill or plate - slightly charred, Kenyan style. NOT American hot dogs.

menu_items.name: Chicken Wings (6 pcs)
menu_items.description: Six chicken wings charcoal-grilled with a spiced dry rub - crispy, smoky and perfectly seasoned
menu_items.image_hint: Six charcoal-grilled chicken wings - crispy, slightly charred, spiced dry rub, served on a plate. Outdoor grill setting. NOT buffalo wings with sauce.

menu_items.name: Nyama Choma Combo
menu_items.description: 200g nyama choma + ugali + kachumbari - the complete Kenyan choma experience
menu_items.image_hint: Nyama choma (grilled meat) + ugali + kachumbari all on one plate or tray - full Kenyan choma meal. This is the combo shot.

menu_items.name: Smokie Pasua
menu_items.description: A smokie (sausage) split open in a bread roll, loaded with kachumbari and chilli sauce
menu_items.image_hint: Smokie pasua - a sausage split open inside a bread roll with kachumbari (tomato, onion, coriander) inside. Iconic Kenyan street food. NOT a hot dog with mustard.

menu_items.name: Samosa ya Nyama
menu_items.description: Crispy triangular pastry filled with spiced minced beef - one piece
menu_items.image_hint: One triangular fried samosa - golden brown, crispy, Kenyan street style. NOT Indian restaurant samosa.

menu_items.name: Samosa ya Mboga
menu_items.description: Crispy triangular pastry filled with spiced potato and vegetable mix - one piece
menu_items.image_hint: One triangular fried vegetable samosa - same golden East African style. Vegetable filling visible if cut.

menu_items.name: Mahamri (3 pcs)
menu_items.description: Three fluffy coconut milk doughnuts - sweet, airy, with a subtle cardamom flavour
menu_items.image_hint: Mahamri - three pieces of East African coconut milk doughnuts. Rounded or triangular, puffy, golden, slightly sweet. NOT American glazed donuts, NOT French beignets.

menu_items.name: Mandazi (3 pcs)
menu_items.description: Three freshly fried Kenyan mandazi - lightly sweetened dough fried golden
menu_items.image_hint: Three mandazi - Kenyan fried dough, often triangular or round, golden brown, slightly puffy. Simple and authentic. NOT a croissant, NOT a beignet.

menu_items.name: Viazi Karai
menu_items.description: Deep-fried potato chunks in spiced chickpea batter - served with chilli kachumbari
menu_items.image_hint: Viazi karai - deep-fried spiced potato in chickpea batter, crispy golden outside. Kenyan coastal street food. NOT regular fries, NOT bhajia.

menu_items.name: Mahindi Choma
menu_items.description: A whole cob of maize slow-roasted over charcoal - salted and chillied to taste
menu_items.image_hint: Mahindi choma - a whole maize cob roasted on charcoal, slightly charred, held by hand or on a plate. Kenyan street style. NOT American corn on the cob with butter.

menu_items.name: Andazi ya Wimbi (3 pcs)
menu_items.description: Three finger millet mandazi - darker, nuttier and more nutritious than regular mandazi
menu_items.image_hint: Mandazi made from wimbi (finger millet) - darker brown colour than regular mandazi, slightly denser, rustic looking. Three pieces.

menu_items.name: Chai + Mandazi (2 pcs)
menu_items.description: A hot mug of Kenyan chai (spiced milk tea) with two freshly fried mandazi
menu_items.image_hint: A mug of Kenyan chai (milky spiced tea) with two mandazi on the side. Simple, warm, morning feel. NOT a latte, NOT coffee, NOT western breakfast.

menu_items.name: Uji wa Wimbi
menu_items.description: Warm finger millet porridge - thick, nutritious and traditionally Kenyan
menu_items.image_hint: Uji wa wimbi - a bowl or mug of dark brown finger millet porridge. Thick, warm. Traditional Kenyan breakfast. NOT oatmeal, NOT cream of wheat.

menu_items.name: Mayai + Chapati (2 pcs)
menu_items.description: Two scrambled or fried eggs served with two fresh chapati
menu_items.image_hint: Scrambled or fried eggs with two chapati on a plate. Simple Kenyan breakfast plate. NOT eggs benedict, NOT an omelette on a fancy plate.

menu_items.name: Mkate + Siagi + Chai
menu_items.description: Sliced white bread with butter and a hot mug of chai - the campus morning classic
menu_items.image_hint: Sliced white bread with butter (mkate na siagi) and a mug of chai. Simple and humble - the budget campus breakfast. NOT fancy toast.

menu_items.name: Uji wa Mahindi
menu_items.description: Warm maize flour porridge - smooth, light and filling
menu_items.image_hint: Uji wa mahindi - a bowl or mug of light white maize porridge. Thin to medium consistency. Traditional Kenyan. NOT grits, NOT polenta.

menu_items.name: Boiled Eggs (2 pcs)
menu_items.description: Two hard-boiled eggs - simple protein hit to kickstart the day
menu_items.image_hint: Two boiled eggs - simple, plain, halved or whole on a plate or napkin. Nothing fancy.

menu_items.name: Porridge (Oats)
menu_items.description: Warm rolled oat porridge with a dash of cinnamon and sugar
menu_items.image_hint: Simple bowl of warm oat porridge with cinnamon or plain. NOT instagram-style acai bowl.

menu_items.name: Pilau ya Nyama
menu_items.description: Classic Kenyan pilau - spiced rice cooked with beef, whole spices and caramelised onions
menu_items.image_hint: Kenyan pilau ya nyama - dark brown fragrant rice with beef pieces, whole spices visible (cumin, cardamom). Served on a plate with kachumbari on the side. NOT Indian biryani presentation, NOT fried rice.

menu_items.name: Pilau ya Kuku
menu_items.description: Fragrant Kenyan pilau cooked with tender chicken pieces and whole aromatic spices
menu_items.image_hint: Kenyan pilau ya kuku - dark brown spiced rice with chicken pieces on a plate. Same style as beef pilau but with chicken visible. Whole spices visible.

menu_items.name: Pilau Jumbo ya Nyama
menu_items.description: Extra large portion of beef pilau - for the seriously hungry student
menu_items.image_hint: Large generous serving of Kenyan beef pilau - heaped on a plate, same dark brown spiced rice, more meat visible.

menu_items.name: Wali wa Biryani
menu_items.description: Kenyan-style biryani rice layered with spiced beef and fried onions
menu_items.image_hint: Kenyan biryani - layered spiced rice with beef and fried onions. More colourful than pilau, golden-brown fried onions on top. NOT Indian restaurant biryani pot.

menu_items.name: Wali wa Maharage
menu_items.description: Plain steamed rice with rich Kenyan-style kidney bean stew
menu_items.image_hint: White rice with thick dark red kidney bean stew. Simple Kenyan plate. NOT rice and peas Jamaican style.

menu_items.name: Wali wa Nazi
menu_items.description: Fragrant coconut milk rice - Swahili coastal style, rich and aromatic
menu_items.image_hint: Wali wa nazi - coconut rice, slightly glossy, white to cream coloured, served on a plate. Swahili coastal style. NOT Thai coconut rice.

menu_items.name: Fried Rice ya Kuku
menu_items.description: Kenyan-style fried rice with chicken pieces, vegetables and egg
menu_items.image_hint: Fried rice with chicken pieces and vegetables. Kenyan campus style - simple, filling, not heavily sauced. NOT Chinese restaurant fried rice.

menu_items.name: Pilau + Kachumbari Combo
menu_items.description: Plate of pilau ya nyama with a generous side of kachumbari and lemon wedge
menu_items.image_hint: Kenyan pilau on a plate with kachumbari (tomato, onion, coriander fresh salsa) on the side and a lemon wedge. The classic combo presentation.

menu_items.name: Chapo Madondo
menu_items.description: Two fresh layered chapati with a rich madondo (boiled bean) stew
menu_items.image_hint: Two soft, layered Kenyan chapati with madondo (boiled beans in thick sauce) on a plate. Classic Kenyan combination. NOT Indian roti and dal.

menu_items.name: Chapo Ndengu
menu_items.description: Two fresh chapati with creamy green gram (ndengu) stew
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati with yellowish-green ndengu (green gram) stew on the side. Kenyan style. NOT Indian moong dal.

menu_items.name: Chapo Nyama
menu_items.description: Two fresh chapati with slow-cooked beef stew - the most popular combo on the menu
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati with chunky beef stew poured beside them. Classic Kenyan chapo-nyama. The stew is dark brown, rich. NOT a wrap.

menu_items.name: Chapo Mayai
menu_items.description: Two chapati with scrambled egg - quick, simple and protein-packed
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati with scrambled egg on the side. Simple, clean plate. Morning or lunch. Kenyan style.

menu_items.name: Chapo Avocado
menu_items.description: Two chapati with sliced ripe avocado and a pinch of salt - student favourite
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati with sliced ripe avocado on the side or on top. Simple Kenyan presentation. NOT avocado toast on sourdough.

menu_items.name: Chipsi Mayai
menu_items.description: Chips omelette - French fries folded into a thick egg omelette. Nairobi's favourite street food
menu_items.image_hint: Chipsi mayai - a thick omelette with chips (french fries) inside, folded or flat, served on a plate. Iconic Kenyan-Tanzanian street food. NOT a frittata, NOT a Spanish tortilla.

menu_items.name: Chapati (1 piece)
menu_items.description: One fresh chapati - order as many as you need
menu_items.image_hint: A single chapati - soft, layered, slightly golden, fresh off the pan. Simple, clean image. NOT naan, NOT roti.

menu_items.name: Chapo Smokie
menu_items.description: Two chapati with a split smokie sausage and kachumbari - a creative campus combo
menu_items.image_hint: Two chapati with a smokie (sausage) and kachumbari on a plate. Creative Kenyan campus combo. Informal, authentic.

menu_items.name: Chips (Small)
menu_items.description: A small portion of hot chips (thick-cut fries) served with tomato sauce
menu_items.image_hint: Kenyan chips - thick-cut fries on a plate or paper with tomato sauce. Street food style. NOT thin McDonald's fries.

menu_items.name: Chips (Large)
menu_items.description: A large portion of thick-cut chips - the full meal deal
menu_items.image_hint: Large serving of Kenyan thick chips on a plate. More chips than the small - same rustic street food style.

menu_items.name: Chips + Kuku (Small)
menu_items.description: Small chips with two pieces of fried chicken - the campus fast food classic
menu_items.image_hint: Chips (thick fries) with two pieces of fried chicken on a plate. Kenyan campus style - NOT a KFC bucket, NOT wax-paper bucket.

menu_items.name: Chips + Kuku (Large)
menu_items.description: Large chips with four pieces of fried chicken - for the seriously hungry
menu_items.image_hint: Large plate of Kenyan chips with four fried chicken pieces - filling, generous portion.

menu_items.name: Chipsi Mayai
menu_items.description: The legendary Nairobi chipsi mayai - chips baked into a golden egg omelette
menu_items.image_hint: Chipsi mayai - omelette with chips inside, served on a plate. Iconic Kenyan-Tanzanian street food.

menu_items.name: Chicken Burger
menu_items.description: Fried chicken fillet in a soft burger bun with lettuce, tomato and chilli mayo
menu_items.image_hint: Chicken burger in a simple bun with lettuce and tomato. Campus-style, NOT a gourmet burger photo. Simple and filling.

menu_items.name: Smokie + Chips
menu_items.description: Two smokies with a portion of chips - quick and filling
menu_items.image_hint: Two smokie sausages beside a portion of chips on a plate. Simple, casual Kenyan campus food.

menu_items.name: Fried Chicken (3 pcs)
menu_items.description: Three pieces of crispy fried chicken - drumstick, wing and thigh
menu_items.image_hint: Three pieces of fried chicken (different cuts) on a plate - crispy, golden, street-style. NOT KFC branding. Kenyan campus presentation.

menu_items.name: Chips + Sausage
menu_items.description: Chips with sliced sausage - simple, fast and satisfying
menu_items.image_hint: Chips (thick fries) with sliced sausage on a plate. Simple campus fast food. NOT a western full breakfast.

menu_items.name: Mango Juice (500ml)
menu_items.description: Fresh-pressed Kenyan mango juice - thick, sweet and 100% natural
menu_items.image_hint: A glass of bright yellow fresh mango juice, possibly with a mango slice on the rim. Natural, no branding. Tropical, vibrant. NOT a bottle of Delmonte.

menu_items.name: Passion Fruit Juice (500ml)
menu_items.description: Freshly squeezed passion fruit juice - tart, fruity and refreshing
menu_items.image_hint: A glass of passion fruit juice - golden yellow, slightly cloudy, seeds possibly visible. Fresh and natural. NOT a cocktail, NOT a smoothie bowl.

menu_items.name: Watermelon Juice (500ml)
